observation: Native coordinates and horizontal gate lines correspond to the ordinary overhead camera view. Accepted seed26 produces several cow-body boxes where official YOLO26n has none in these sampled panels. Some boxes or captions at the image boundary are clipped by the source framing. No count, recall or identity truth is inferred from these pictures alone.
native_image_boundaries_and_cold_start: All sessions are only about 5.3 seconds and some animals already straddle a gate or remain in view at clip end. Zero events can reflect incomplete A-to-B observations as well as sparse detections or tracking interruptions; absence of an event is not itself a proven physical miss.
caption_readability: Paired title, model sides, frame numbers and reference-pending notice are legible. Embedded video HUD text is small in the 640-wide contact panels; original 1280-wide videos are provided for reading details.
visual_acceptance: PASS for these extracted still panels and native scene geometry
